name: Beloe eho
source: Englishman Jonathan Brown had lived in Russia for fourteen years, but had to return to his homeland in 1918 because of Russian Civil War. Five years after that, when doing his ordinary work in London office, he didn't guess that echo of his russian past would reach him very soon, and he even had no idea he would hear Night Kingdom demons' voices after that.
